 * 3 February – A high court judge rules Greenpeace activists who stopped an oil tanker are not guilty of causing a public nuisance.
 * 6 February – A by-election is held in Christchurch, following the death of Christopher Chope.

 * 27 February – Mark Carney, as Canada's new Prime Minister, visits the UK.

 * 3 April – Tesco announces it will cut 400 management jobs.
 * 9 April – The UK and US reach a tentative deal on tariffs.
 * 22 April – It is announced that King Charles III has been in remission from cancer for a year.
 * 22 April – Plans are announced for a road tunnel under Stonehenge.
 * 1 May – Local council elections are held in England.
 * 7 May – The UK and EU announce a new defence and trade agreement.
 * 13 May – The UK and US formally reach a trade deal.
 * 14 May – The UK and India formally reach a trade deal.
 * 16 May – An earthquake measuring 3.8 in magnitude strikes near Blackpool.
 * 16 May – A fire breaks out at an asylum seeker hotel in Newquay, Cornwall.
 * 3 June – A fire breaks out in a textile factory in Bradford, West Yorkshire.
